content.name: Host Filesystem Memory Adapter
content.description: SAFOR Memory adapter for a host-provided persistent filesystem or mounted volume.

model.eligibilityRule: The host must explicitly expose a persistent path or mounted storage and SAFOR must prove it can reopen the same stable location after session boundaries. Ephemeral scratch space is ineligible.
model.sharedTeamEligibility: Only when the host additionally proves memory.shared_access and either memory.compare_and_swap or memory.lock.
model.revisionStrategy: Use a durable SAFOR revision metadata record and atomic replacement/locking semantics exposed by the host.
model.forbiddenAssumption: A local path is not durable merely because a file write succeeded once.
model.persistenceProof: The host must prove the same stable location survives session boundaries and can be reopened before it becomes authoritative SAFOR Memory.

content.name: SaaS Engineering Reference Operating Model
content.description: Role, mandate, capability and decision-authority model for a SaaS engineering organization. It intentionally defines no value-stream ordering.

separationOfDuties.rule: When a factory work item requires independent technical review, the approving reviewer actor must differ from the contribution author actor.
Security evidence may not be substituted by the implementation author's self-attestation when independent security review is required.

content.name: Book Authoring Reference Operating Model
content.description: Reference organization for creating a non-fiction or professional book. It maps capabilities and authorities to roles but does not prescribe chapter or publication flow.

separationOfDuties.rule: When independent fact checking is required, the fact-checking actor must differ from the author of the reviewed content.
A configured independent proofread must be performed by an actor other than the author of the final manuscript revision.

content.name: Software Delivery and Outcome Factory
content.description: Provider-neutral software value-creation factory from product intent through delivery, activation and outcome assessment. The factory requests abstract capabilities and authorities and contains no role IDs.

outcomeModel.rule: A delivered or activated product is not evidence that the declared value hypothesis has been achieved.

discoveryContract.purpose: Understand the user problem, intended value, solution form and minimum useful software/website scope before planning.

requiredFields.prompt: Wer soll die Software oder Website hauptsächlich nutzen?
Welches konkrete Problem soll sie lösen?
Woran erkennen wir später, dass sie echten Nutzen liefert?
Was ist die kleinste wirklich nutzbare erste Version?

planningContract.rule: Planning must be derived only from the confirmed software/website discovery and this factory graph.

evidenceContract.rule: Evidence is work-item-type specific and must come from provider/artifact readback or another authoritative bound source.

outputProvenance.rule: Every persisted factory output must have a SAFOR output provenance record. LLM/provider/model/version values may only be recorded when actually exposed by the host.

workspaceRequirements.rule: Software/Website work requires a versioned work provider. Review, issue and CI capabilities are optional unless a work item explicitly requires them.

content.name: Book Production and Reader Outcome Factory
content.description: Reference book-creation factory proving that the SAFOR MASTER kernel can orchestrate a non-software domain without changing kernel semantics.

outcomeModel.rule: Publication is delivery. Reader understanding, behavior or other declared reader value requires separate outcome evidence.

discoveryContract.purpose: Understand intended readers, reader need, core promise, evidence standard and minimum coherent book scope before planning.

requiredFields.prompt: Für wen schreibst du dieses Buch?
Was sollen die Leser danach besser verstehen oder können?
Was ist die zentrale Aussage oder das Versprechen des Buches?
Woran erkennen wir später, dass das Buch seinen Lesern nutzt?
Welchen Anspruch soll das Buch an Quellen und Nachweise haben?
Was ist der kleinste in sich stimmige publizierbare Umfang?

planningContract.rule: Planning must be derived only from the confirmed book discovery and this factory graph.

evidenceContract.rule: Evidence must demonstrate source quality, manuscript transformation and independent review appropriate to the selected evidence standard.

outputProvenance.rule: Every persisted factory output must have a SAFOR output provenance record. LLM/provider/model/version values may only be recorded when actually exposed by the host.

workspaceRequirements.rule: Book work may remain entirely inside SAFOR Memory when the HUMAN chooses that mode, or use an external versioned workspace when available.

content.purpose: Declarative architecture checks for SAFOR v0.5.0 provider-neutral Memory, multi-session collaboration and output provenance.

assertions.statement: SAFOR-MASTER.json is the single portable bootstrap entrypoint.
Kernel requires OPERATING_MODEL, FACTORY and PROVIDER_ADAPTER bindings.
Factory packages reference capabilities/authorities but contain no roleId bindings.
Every capability required by the software factory is exported by the SaaS engineering operating model.
Every authority required by the software factory is exported by the SaaS engineering operating model.
Every capability required by the book factory is exported by the book authoring operating model.
Every authority required by the book factory is exported by the book authoring operating model.
Provider adapters export only capabilities known to the kernel provider capability vocabulary.
Global schemas contain no safomwebsite-specific migration constant.
Work-item type is a factory-defined string and is not a kernel domain enum.
Control, value-stream and execution states are separate aggregates.
Delivery completion is distinct from outcome validation.
Kernel references a dedicated interaction model and interaction-menu schema.
A state-aware menu is required at user-relevant stable checkpoints.
NEXT_ROUND is bounded by existing authorization and stops before any new human decision or authority expansion.
Native clickable actions are preferred only when the host actually exposes a supported interaction capability.
Recommendations are advisory until explicitly selected and are ranked from current state/evidence.
Danger actions are visually separated and require confirmation.
Direct HUMAN communication uses the SAFOR_HUMAN_BUDDY profile.
Routine checkpoint communication is concise by default and governed by explicit response budgets.
HUMAN messages lead with the useful result, decision or next action instead of tool/process narration.
Technical state and evidence detail are progressively disclosed through Details unless immediately necessary.
Encouragement is specific and evidence-grounded; generic praise, exaggeration and emotional manipulation are forbidden.
Expanded detail remains available whenever the HUMAN requests it or material risk requires it.
Loading SAFOR-MASTER starts guided initialization by discovering eligible Memory providers, not by hard-coding GitHub/GitLab.
Creation type and project work are blocked until a Memory provider proves durable read/write/revision/resume capabilities.
Missing GitHub/GitLab alone is not a blocker; absence of any eligible durable Memory provider causes STOP without requesting credentials in chat.
The HUMAN explicitly selects or approves the Memory provider and physical owner (HUMAN or ORGANIZATION).
The HUMAN explicitly selects PERSONAL or SHARED_TEAM collaboration mode.
SHARED_TEAM requires shared access plus compare-and-swap or lock style concurrency.
Memory provider selection is independent from work/SCM provider selection.
Creation of a new Memory location requires explicit HUMAN approval and actual create capability.
Project state persists a Memory binding with owner, provider, stable location, verified capabilities and concurrency strategy.
All HUMAN interaction is restricted to chat-native UI surfaces exposed by the host.
Custom web UI, HTML, CSS, JavaScript UI shells, iframes and forced color theming are forbidden.
SAFOR controls interaction semantics and labels but not host-owned button colors or dropdown styling.
When native buttons/selects are unavailable, fallback is native Markdown/plain text only.
Kernel references a conservative self-healing model and repair-record schema.
Self-healing has explicit detect, classify, plan, execute and verify stages.
Automatic repairs are limited to existing authorization and proven provider capabilities.
Retries are bounded by failure-class and operation budgets; unknown mutation effects reconcile before retry.
Every repair requires authoritative readback before success and persists an immutable repair record.
Human gates, reviews, mandates and policy guards cannot be bypassed by self-healing.
Force-push, history rewrite, destructive repository deletion and invented evidence are forbidden automatic repairs.
When automatic recovery is unsafe or exhausted, SAFOR escalates concisely to the HUMAN with the smallest required action.
SAFOR Memory is provider-neutral and may be backed by a versioned repository, durable host filesystem or compliant custom provider.
A one-time successful write is not sufficient; Memory durability and resume semantics must be proven.
No authoritative project state required later may exist only in chat context.
The HUMAN must explicitly choose exactly one creation type: SOFTWARE_WEBSITE or BOOK.
Creation type deterministically selects the compatible Factory and Operating Model pair.
Software/Website and Book factories each define their own discoveryContract, planningContract and evidenceContract.
D01 Discovery resolves only the bound Factory discoveryContract.
P01 Planning resolves only the same bound Factory planningContract and confirmed Discovery.
E04/E05 persist output provenance and evaluate domain evidence only against the same bound Factory evidenceContract.
Project descriptor persists creationType and Memory binding reference and remains consistent with pinned package bindings.
Every persisted Factory output has a SAFOR output provenance record containing producer/session identity, Memory revision and pinned SAFOR/Factory/Operating-Model versions.
LLM provider/model/version provenance records only host-observed values; unavailable values remain null with NOT_EXPOSED rather than being guessed.
A fresh session can rehydrate project state from SAFOR Memory and pinned packages without prior chat history.
Generic Git and Plastic SCM / Unity Version Control are modeled as optional capability-based work-provider adapters; tool availability is never inferred from the manifest.
Host-filesystem Memory is eligible only when the host proves persistence and resume semantics; ephemeral scratch storage is rejected.
Software/Website requires a versioned work provider while Book may use Memory-only mode when the HUMAN chooses it.
Every active HUMAN/agent/service session is registered with session identity, host/LLM observability and base Memory revision.
Shared Memory revision conflicts enter RECONCILE_REQUIRED and cannot overwrite unseen state.
The package system supports MEMORY_PROVIDER_ADAPTER as an independent package kind and requires one bound Memory provider for every project.
Memory or work provider product names never count as proof of capabilities; actual host/provider evidence is required.
